terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: Welcome to Pinksea. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to the following terms:<title>1. Eligibility</title>You must be at least 18 years old to use this service. By using the platform, you confirm you are of legal age in your jurisdiction.<title>2. Content</title>All content on the platform is fictional and created by artificial intelligence. Any resemblance to real individuals is purely coincidental.<title>3. Payments</title>- All payments grant one-time access to a specific creator’s content.- All sales are final. No refunds will be provided under any circumstances.- Optional tips can be sent to creators (also AI-generated). These are also non-refundable.<title>4. Ownership</title>All content and revenue belong solely to Pinksea. Users do not obtain any ownership or licensing rights by purchasing access to content.<title>5. User Conduct</title>Users may not:- Share or distribute content from the platform.- Attempt to impersonate or contact the creators.- Violate any local, national, or international laws in connection with the use of the platform.<title>6. Limitation of Liability</title>We provide the service “as is” without warranties. We are not responsible for damages arising from use of the platform.<title>7. Modifications</title>We may update these terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.<title>8. Contact</title>For any questions, contact us at: admin@pinksea.me

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: Pinksea is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data.<title>1. Information We Collect</title>We may collect:- Email address (if provided)- Payment information (processed by third-party providers)- Usage data (pages viewed, time spent, etc.)We do not collect personal chats or messages, as no messaging exists on the platform.<title>2. How We Use Information</title>- To deliver purchased content- To process payments- To improve our services- To comply with legal obligations<title>3. Sharing of Information</title>We do not sell your data. We may share it with:- Payment processors- Analytics providers- Legal authorities if required<title>4. Data Security</title>We use reasonable measures to protect your data. However, no system is 100% secure.<title>5. Your Rights</title>Depending on your location, you may have rights to:- Access your data- Delete your data- Correct inaccurate dataContact us to make a request: admin@pinksea.me<title>6. Cookies</title>We may use cookies to improve functionality and analyze usage.<title>7. Changes to This Policy</title>We may update this policy at any time. Continued use of the service means you accept the changes.<title>8. Contact</title>For privacy concerns, email: admin@pinksea.me
